add_metrology_object_line_measure — MEASURE1D model op

• Data kinds: metrologymodel → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.add_metrology_object_line_measure(model, row1, col1, row2, col2, n: 'int' = 25) -> 'int' (to call the implementation directly, import metrology; metrology.add_metrology_object_line_measure(model, row1, col1, row2, col2, n: 'int' = 25) -> 'int'; from the registry, opsmeasure1d.get("add_metrology_object_line_measure"))

Usage

Adds a line metrology object (add_metrology_object_line_measure). Returns the index.

Stacks the reference segment (row1, col1) → (row2, col2) [px] onto model["objects"] (the dict is updated in place). apply_metrology_model places n points on this segment at equal spacing (both ends included), from each point stretches a short measuring line along the normal of the segment, searches for the sub-pixel edge, and refits a straight line to the found points by least squares.

• n: number of sample points (default 25). More points make the fit more stable, but the measuring time is proportional.

• A segment whose end points coincide (length < 1e-9) can be stacked, but at apply time 0 samples → treated as a failed fit and returned with params=None, rms=inf (no exception).

• Argument types and ranges are not validated here (coordinates outside the image can be stacked too; at apply time they are only extrapolated by nearest neighbour, no exception is raised).

• Returns: index of the added object (starting at 0). At the same position in the result list of apply is the result with type="line" (row1/col1/row2/col2/angle_deg).

When translating with align_metrology_model, both end points move together.
